notes.title: School Cafeteria Simulator v5.1 is Now Live!
notes.content:
- New Staff to help you restock your Cafetaria Stalls: W.O.L.E.S!
- New Food Vendor: Kacang Rebus!
- New Premium Feature: Upgrade N.O.D.E.H and W.O.L.E.S to make them faster and also to extend their battery life!
- New Toy Shop Booth: Yoyo!
- New Premium Toy Shop Booth: Trading Card!
- Bug fixes

=====================================================================

- Staff baru untuk membantumu menambahkan stok ke Stan Kantin: W.O.L.E.S!
